emergency.name: Emergency Private Interview Intensive
emergency.contact_explanation: Online enrollment for Emergency Intensive is being arranged. If your interview is within 7 days, contact us now so we can determine whether Dr Brian can accommodate the emergency timeline.

faq.question: What is Emergency Private Interview Intensive?
faq.answer: Private, concentrated preparation for a real residency interview 7 days or less away. Tuition is $3,999, subject to confirming that Dr Brian can accommodate your timeline.

faq.question: Who should choose Emergency Intensive?
faq.answer: Applicants with a real residency interview within 7 days who need last-minute private preparation. If you still have time to train properly, we recommend IV Prep Complete instead.

faq.question: What does Emergency Intensive include?
faq.answer: 4 total private 1:1 hours with Dr Brian, including 3 Signature Mock Interviews, personalized strategy and answer/content development, plus interview/program-specific preparation. Each mock uses personalized simulation, structured analysis, debrief and an individualized action plan.

faq.question: Does Emergency include Interview Week?
faq.answer: No. Interview Week / Essentials is not included.

faq.question: Does Emergency include IV Prep Complete?
faq.answer: No. It does not include Complete, its full-season group pathway or Complete-specific entitlements.

faq.question: Does Emergency include a Match Guarantee?
faq.answer: No. Emergency Intensive does not include a Match Guarantee.

faq.question: Why does Emergency cost more than Complete?
faq.answer: It requires concentrated, last-minute private access and Dr Brian to clear or rearrange his schedule. It is an emergency option, not our best-value pathway.

faq.question: Should I choose Emergency or Complete?
faq.answer: If you still have time to train properly, choose Complete. It costs less at current campaign tuition, includes Interview Week and continues preparation throughout interview season.

faq.question: Can I buy Emergency online right now?
faq.answer: Online enrollment is being arranged. Use REQUEST EMERGENCY PREP to contact Mission Residency and determine whether Dr Brian can accommodate your timeline. No appointment is promised until confirmed.

faq.question: What is 360 Match Mentorship?
faq.answer: Mission Residency’s highest-touch, one-to-one mentorship model. Tuition is $5,499; it is currently SOLD OUT.

faq.question: Can I enroll in 360 Match Mentorship?
faq.answer: No. 360 Match Mentorship is currently SOLD OUT and is not available for purchase.

faq.question: Which option should I choose?
faq.answer: Choose Interview Week for the live foundational kickoff. Choose Complete when you want Interview Week plus continued practice, personalized feedback, and interview-season coaching.

faq.question: Do I buy both programs?
faq.answer: No. IV Prep Complete includes Interview Week. The two prices are never added together.

faq.question: Does Interview Week include an individual Signature Mock?
faq.answer: No individual Signature Mock Interview is included in Interview Week tuition. A limited standalone reservation opportunity may be offered separately.

faq.question: What is a Signature Mock?
faq.answer: A live, personalized interview simulation followed by structured analysis, a debrief, and an individualized action plan. Your confirmation states the exact details included in your enrollment.

faq.question: What happens after I enroll?
faq.answer: Keep your confirmation, use the same MissionMed account for My Account and My Courses, and follow the approved schedule and placement details supplied with your enrollment.

faq.question: Are the evening times final?
faq.answer: No exact evening clock time is published yet. Use only the approved schedule supplied with your enrollment.

faq.question: Is September the last training opportunity?
faq.answer: No. The next foundational training is anticipated around November 8, 2026.

faq.question: Do you guarantee a Match?
faq.answer: No. No coach can guarantee a Match. Mission Residency provides preparation, practice, feedback, and strategy.

faq.question: How can I pay?
faq.answer: Interview Week is $549 by card or $499 by Zelle; choose Zelle at checkout. A Zelle order stays on hold, and course access opens once MissionMed confirms receipt of your payment. Complete is available pay in full ($3,099 early tuition) or on a payment plan ($1,000 today + 6 monthly installments, $3,400 total). Complete checkout is by card.
